U1 · Robotics, democratized

Start with a robot that works. Make it yours.

We're a small team from Novi Sad building robots on camera, failures included, and teaching what we learn. Bringup is the tool we use to design them: boards, printed parts, firmware and the parts list, kept in agreement.

Join the testers Early testing. Free while we learn.
J1 · The series

Zero to Robot

We document our first robot from a sentence to its first drive. Each episode teaches one thing you'd need to build your own.

  1. EP 1
    We describe a robot to an AI and watch what it designs.
  2. EP 2
    What it chose, and why every part explained.
  3. EP 3
    What a robot really costs the order, line by line.
  4. EP 4
    Soldering and assembly learn it with us.
  5. EP 5
    First power-on smoke or no smoke.
  6. EP 6
    First drive and what broke on the way.

J3 · Try it now

Already use Claude Code? Add Bringup in one line.

Bringup is an MCP server. Add it, then ask Claude to start a design from one of our starter robots.

claude mcp add bringup -- npx -y bringup-mcp

Needs Node.js 22 or newer. Early and rough, so expect sharp edges. npm · GitHub
